waypoints.name: Surprise Lake
waypoints.note: Trail switchbacks above the lake to join the PCT.

waypoints.name: Trap Pass
waypoints.note: PCT junction; the climbers path to Thunder Mountain and Slippery Slab Tower leaves directly from the top of the pass.

waypoints.name: Base of Slippery Slab Tower
waypoints.note: Corrected - previous coordinate (47.665,-121.22) jumped ~4.5mi west of Trap Pass instead of continuing toward the tower, likely a data entry error. Real tower location sourced via Peakbagger (47.668645,-121.126119, elev 6356ft), matching this area's own registered location.

waypoints.name: Slippery Slab Tower NE Face Topout
waypoints.note: Corrected - previous coordinate (47.6636,-121.2226) was ~4.5mi off, confirmed via Peakbagger (pid 2167) cross-checked against this area's own registered location. Two-pitch 5.4; Pitch 2 diagonals left into a gully to a large boulder near the top.

waypoints.name: Tunnel Creek Trailhead
waypoints.note: FS Rd 6095, ~13.2 mi east of Skykomish off US-2; approach is Tunnel Creek Trail -> PCT (Hope Lake) -> south to Trap Pass -> climbers trail to NE base of tower
